fixes.symptom: Nuxt build succeeds with unresolved generated handlers, but the built Node server exits with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Workspace plugin is registered relative to server/; Windows handler paths contain backslashes that are interpreted as JavaScript escapes.
fixes.environment: Windows; Node 24.22.1; Bun 1.4.4; Nuxt 4.6.2 / Nitro 2.13.5; Vite 8.3.5; selected full-commit preview
fixes.reproduction: Remove generatedPaths from fixture modules, run bun run build, then node .output/server/index.mjs. Observed unmodified failure before adding the workaround.
fixes.removalCondition: On Windows and Linux, remove the module registration/file and verify clean install, prepare, build and the built Node/Worker probes without unresolved generated imports. Retain the runtime regression. The module is fixture-local until phase 1 passes; no application patch has been applied.

fixes.symptom: Workspace require shim evaluates in a non-entry chunk before Node entry initialization. Nitro supplies file:///_entry.js, which createRequire rejects on Windows.
fixes.reproduction: After normalizing generated paths, build the unpatched Node fixture and run verify-node.mjs: ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE for file:///_entry.js.
fixes.removalCondition: Remove both root/consumer patchedDependencies and both patch copies, reinstall, then build and run the Node probe on Windows/Linux. Non-entry import.meta must initialize with a valid actual module URL. Keep the runtime probe.

fixes.symptom: Enabling Console traces libSQL JS and package metadata but omits win32-x64-msvc/index.node; the production server exits with MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
fixes.reproduction: Enable fixture Console without libsqlNative, build, then run verify-node.mjs.
fixes.removalCondition: Remove the registration/file and verify the installed Windows x64 native binding is included automatically and the built Console consumer starts. Other platforms are not covered by this workaround.

fixes.symptom: Nuxt Cloudflare Console build tries to resolve unused optional advocaat / Discord / Teams peers. The first failure is Cannot resolve advocaat and externals are not allowed.
fixes.reproduction: bun run test:vitehub:cloudflare without this patch fails resolving advocaat.
fixes.verification: The built Console Worker boots under workerd without these unused optional peers; Auth, Content, Database constraints and offline mock Agents execute.
fixes.removalCondition: Remove consumer patchedDependencies and both patch copies, reinstall the selected fixed distribution, then pass Cloudflare build and workerd Auth/Content/Console/mock-Agent tests with those optional peers absent. Retain the regression. App patch propagation is pending the package gate.

fixes.symptom: cachedSource imports nitro/cache (Nitro 3), pulling its H3 2 runtime through Nuxt Nitro 2/H3 1 aliases and failing at h3/rules.
fixes.reproduction: Remove nitroCache registration and build the Cloudflare fixture: h3/dist/index.mjs/rules cannot resolve.
fixes.removalCondition: Remove registration/file and pass Node/Worker builds plus the real cachedSource key-isolation/runtime check. The alias targets the host's native Nitro cache implementation, never an empty module.

fixes.symptom: The Nuxt bridge forwards resolver hooks but omits the Env Vite transform. Wrangler then cannot resolve the computed #vitehub/env/server import in built server code.
fixes.reproduction: With the cache workaround but without this patch, build the Cloudflare fixture and start verify-cloudflare.mjs: unresolved #vitehub/env/server.
fixes.removalCondition: Remove the consumer entry and both copies, reinstall the fixed distribution and boot the built Node/Console Worker without unresolved Env imports. The patch forwards only the installed Env plugin transform.

fixes.symptom: Nitro adds no_nodejs_compat_v2 even for modern compatibility dates, disabling the native Node modules required by the compiled ViteHub Console. Wrangler fails at fs/child_process in detect-libc.
fixes.reproduction: Without this patch hunk, boot the generated Cloudflare fixture: bare fs/child_process fail. Explicit nodejs_compat_v2 also conflicts with ViteHub's nodejs_compat flag.
fixes.removalCondition: Remove this hunk from both copies and pass the modern-date generated-config assertions and workerd probe without overriding the generated flags. Legacy dates retain the old default.

fixes.symptom: The generated Schedule plugin imports definePlugin from Nitro 3 even in Nuxt's Nitro 2 host. Build fails because H3 1 has no toRequest export.
fixes.reproduction: Enable schedule: true and remove schedulePlugin from Nuxt modules; the Cloudflare build fails at nitro/dist/runtime/nitro.mjs importing toRequest.
fixes.removalCondition: Remove registration/file and pass builds and the discovered Worker scheduled handler with native Nitro 2. Only the generated Schedule plugin import is transformed; native defineNitroPlugin and the original handler remain intact.

featureGaps.evidence: Installed Content DocumentsOptions offers schema fields and Markdown components. ConsoleSchemaFieldKind and ConsoleDocumentActionName enumerate fixed field/action sets; contributed sections/pages also use fixed built-in views. No arbitrary relation-picker, translation-operation or proofreading-button slot is exposed by these contracts.
featureGaps.decision: Prefer native Console for models whose invariants it can enforce. Implement only missing model controls in Liti Nuxt admin pages behind the same server authorization/validation boundary; do not copy Console internals or patch new features into upstream.

featureGaps.evidence: Native Content schedule calls publish({ expect }) and intentionally fails after draft edits. This is not a bug.
featureGaps.decision: Use a native Schedule Definition to publish an immutable Workspace revision. Store queue metadata in a Workspace ref and commit a receipt with published content in one native history CAS commit; later drafts are untouched. Revalidate authorization/model rules at execution. Do not rely on the scheduler's default run store for exactly-once publication.
featureGaps.owner: Model publication integrity + ViteHub Schedule; production implementation in phase 3
